sub_indicators.norm_short: The AU Digital Education Strategy asks for a national research and education network in every country by 2027; Agenda 2063's second ten-year plan asks for 40 per cent of graduates in STEM by 2033.
criteria: The latest figure, for 2023 or later, puts STEM graduates below 13 per cent of tertiary graduates.
STEM graduates are 13 per cent or more of tertiary graduates, in the latest figure for 2023 or later, from UNESCO's series.
STEM graduates are 27 per cent or more of tertiary graduates.
STEM graduates are 40 per cent or more of tertiary graduates.
STEM graduates are 40 per cent or more of tertiary graduates, and a national research and education network is in service connecting the public universities.
